athlete.title: Athlete dashboard
athlete.intro: You earn points every time someone else buys using your code. Your own purchases don't earn points, but you can redeem the ones you collect on your orders like any customer.

athlete.footnote: Rewards are confirmed once the order's payment completes and are reversed if the order is cancelled or returned.
